Hi David,

Thanks for the heads-up that our renewal is coming up in January. We wanted to kick off coordination from our side so we can lock in the commit runway and avoid any capacity surprises for H1. High-level context: StratifyAI expects a ~50% throughput increase in January (new feature launch) and we'd like to align on term/price and a plan for staged capacity uplift.

Can we schedule a renewal/QBR conversation in the next two weeks? Proposed week: Nov 29 - Dec 3.

Immediate asks from us:
- Confirm available QBR windows (30-60 min)
- Share the latest Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and any SOW/term drafts
- Quick run of usage by model/pattern (attachment)
- Security/compliance checklist (to invite our security lead)

I've attached our current_usage_report.pdf for context.

Thanks,
Eliot Gardner
Head of Platform Engineering
StratifyAI

- Tue, Dec 1 at 11:00 PT
- Wed, Dec 2 at 14:00 PT

If neither works, suggest two alternatives and we'll accommodate.

I'll loop in Monica (customer success) and Karthik (solutions/infra) so we can bring a MAP and preliminary sizing. Action items on our side before the call:
- Share Mutual_Action_Plan_v1 (Drive link)
- Preliminary cost/throughput scenarios for Dedicated vs Hosted burst
